parrafo.es: Clean Bites Pet Services llega a tu casa en Broward, Miami-Dade y Palm Beach para limpiar los dientes de tu perro o gato sin sedación, además de corte y limado de uñas, todo en la calma de tu propia sala.
parrafo.en: Clean Bites Pet Services comes to your home across Broward, Miami-Dade and Palm Beach to clean your dog's or cat's teeth without sedation, plus nail clipping and filing, all in the calm of your own living room.

hero.imagen_alt: Dog wrapped in a blue towel after a mobile teeth cleaning visit with Clean Bites Pet Services

parrafo_1.es: Clean Bites Pet Services es un servicio móvil de cuidado dental para mascotas que atiende Broward, Miami-Dade y Palm Beach. Barbara y su equipo llegan a tu casa para realizar limpiezas dentales sin anestesia y corte y limado de uñas, sin que tu perro o gato tenga que ser sedado ni salir de casa.
parrafo_1.en: Clean Bites Pet Services is a mobile pet care company serving Broward, Miami-Dade and Palm Beach counties. Barbara and her team come to your home to perform anesthesia-free dental cleanings along with nail clipping and filing, so your dog or cat never has to be sedated or leave the house.

parrafo_2.es: En nuestras reseñas de Google se repite lo mismo: paciencia real con mascotas nerviosas, un reporte dental claro después de cada limpieza y recomendaciones para cuidar sus dientes entre visita y visita.
parrafo_2.en: The same thing keeps coming up in our Google reviews: real patience with nervous pets, a clear dental report after every cleaning, and coaching on how to keep your pet's teeth healthy between visits.

texto.es: Nos escribes por WhatsApp y nos cuentas la especie, raza y tamaño de tu mascota, y qué necesita.
texto.en: Message us on WhatsApp and tell us your pet's species, breed and size, and what they need.

texto.es: Coordinamos un día y horario que te funcione dentro de Broward, Miami-Dade o Palm Beach.
texto.en: We set up a day and time that works for you, anywhere across Broward, Miami-Dade or Palm Beach.

texto.es: Hacemos la limpieza dental y el corte de uñas con calma, en tu propia sala, sin sedación.
texto.en: We perform the teeth cleaning and nail trim at a calm pace, right in your own living room, no sedation.

texto.es: Te explicamos lo que encontramos y cómo mantener sus dientes sanos hasta la próxima visita.
texto.en: We walk you through what we found and how to keep your pet's teeth healthy until the next visit.

nota.es: Cada visita se cotiza según el tamaño y la necesidad dental de tu mascota. Escríbenos por WhatsApp y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every visit is quoted based on your pet's size and dental needs. Message us on WhatsApp and we will walk you through it, no obligation.

texto.es: Raspado y pulido completo sin sedación, hecho con calma en tu propia casa, con reporte dental y recomendaciones de cuidado.
texto.en: Full scaling and polishing without sedation, done calmly in your own home, with a dental report and aftercare tips for every pet.

texto.es: Corte y limado de uñas en la misma visita, sin necesidad de otra cita, ideal para mascotas que se ponen ansiosas en el veterinario.
texto.en: Nail trimming and filing in the same visit, no extra appointment needed, for pets who get anxious at the vet or groomer.

texto.es: Después de cada limpieza te explicamos lo que encontramos y cómo cuidar sus dientes hasta la próxima visita.
texto.en: After every cleaning we walk you through what we found and how to keep your pet's teeth healthy until the next visit.

pie.es: ¿Tienes dudas sobre los dientes o uñas de tu mascota? Escríbenos igual, te orientamos sin compromiso.
pie.en: Have a question about your pet's teeth or nails? Reach out anyway, we will guide you with no obligation.

items.quote: I can't recommend Clean Bites enough! I have a 1-year-old male Golden Retriever, Coop, who is about as wild and energetic as they come. When Barbara first walked in, he was barking at her and acting a little nervous, and I thought there was…

Arya had the best experience with Barbra! Barbra is sweet and personable with a very professional approach to teeth cleaning. I loved Aryas dental report and teeth care instructions after her cleaning. I will definitely be booking Arya to…

Barbara is amazing!!!! Our Jack (who could normally be handful) was so calm during his teeth cleaning and nail trim. We are amazed with what a difference it made! Barbara also took the time to sit with us afterwards to explain everything and coach us on future care. All this from the comfort of our home. Thank you Barbara!!!
